atoms.text: Es gibt Sonderfälle von gesteigerten Adverbien, die auswendig gelernt werden müssen.

example.a:
Chrissy saved a little.
Yuri saved less.
Jillian saved the least.
example.sound: ssml: Chrissy saved a little. Yuri saved less. Jillian saved the least.

instruction.text: Tippe auf die Adverbien im Text.

atoms.b: My mother can explain things to me ((well)), but my brother can explain them even ((better)). My older sister explains things to me ((the best)).

instruction.text: Ordne den Sonderfällen den jeweiligen Komparativ und Superlativ zu.

instruction.text: Entscheide, um welche Steigerungsform es sich bei dem Adverb im Satz handelt.

atoms.a: Last year, Joy played volleyball badly, but she practised every day to get better.
My parents enjoy hiking the most because they love the view and the nature.
Bruno enjoys running less than cycling because he finds it more exhausting.
Aleesha performs the worst when she is feeling tired.
Elijah trains more when he doesn't have so much homework to do.

instruction.text: Vervollständige die Sätze, indem du die Adverbien in den richtigen Steigerungsformen in die Lücken schreibst.

atoms.a: Sie lacht mehr, wenn sie Zeit mit ihrer besten Freundin verbringt.
atoms.b: She laughs ((more)) when she spends time with her best friend.
